meta.title: Dean Haddock — Portfolio & Resume
meta.author: Dean Haddock
meta.contactMessage: Open to select board advisory appointments, enterprise product leadership consultations, and high-impact technology initiatives.

summary: Empathetic tech leader, systems thinker, creative problem solver and engineer who has built and scaled multiple SaaS platforms in competitive markets. Deep expertise in product strategy, AI, automation, and high-scale technical innovation. Nieman Fellow, Planning Commissioner and entrepreneur.

competencies.description: Product Management & Strategy (SaaS, Web & Mobile), Platform, Security, PLG, Pricing & Packaging, AI Integration & Strategy, Stakeholder Relations, Sales
Product & Engineering Team Leadership, Mentoring, Cross-functional Culture & Collaboration, Process Improvement, Efficiency, Mission & Vision, AI Adoption
Full-Stack Development (Node.js, LAMP, JS, UX), AI & Automation, Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Linux), SDLC, Systems Engineering, Security, Agentic Coding & Prototyping

roles.title: Group Product Manager, Platform & Hosting
highlights: Led platform, hosting, data engineering, security & access, administration, and provisioning teams.
Delivered SaaS products and core platform features, including APIs, analytics, hosting, notifications, administration, global navigation, CLIs, MCPs, RBAC and security tools.
Executed the product and technical change strategy from single- to multi-product SaaS platform.

roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Platform & Hosting
highlights: Launched a new multi-cloud, multi-region, enterprise-grade Node web application hosting platform.
Exceeded financial and user adoption goals by over 2x in Y1 with continued sustained growth.
Partnered with UX, engineering, support and sales teams to align efforts and drive successful product launches and customer outcomes.

roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Plans & Packaging
highlights: Led pricing and packaging strategies to transform the business from a single-product to a multi-product SaaS model.
Simplified complex back-of-house provisioning systems, data layer architecture and observability for customers and internal teams.
Co-founded Contentstack's Internal Advisory Board and Toastmasters Club to foster cross-team collaboration.
Recognized with the Contentstack Care award for outstanding collaboration with customers and colleagues.

roles.title: Associate Director, New Client Strategy
highlights: Built and managed a $10M+ portfolio of technology projects for enterprises and scale-ups, including Blackstone, Microsoft, Hilton, VMware, T-Mobile, Groundworks, Samsung, Merck, Glazer Vision Foundation and more.
Led digital and product strategies across all SDLC phases to deliver top-quality results for major, high-profile initiatives.
Crafted strategy presentations, detailed project budgets, estimates and scopes of work that succeeded on time, budget and goal.
Reviewed contracts, responded to RFPs and navigated procurement processes for new clients and partners, including government agencies.
Managed, hired, mentored and led diverse staff and technical product teams.

roles.title: Managing Director, Digital & Technical Innovation
highlights: Led StoryCorps' digital organization, achieving recognition by the Knight Foundation, Nieman Foundation for Journalism, Webby Awards and more.
Spearheaded the 2015 TED Prize project for the StoryCorps App & Archive SaaS platform, creating the world's largest oral history archive.
Presented at conferences, explored new partnerships and published thought leadership pieces discussing industry technology solutions.
Cultivated strategic relationships with Apple, Google, Amazon, the United States Library of Congress, and multiple INGOs.
Founded a diverse Digital & Technical Innovation team and established a pipeline from local colleges to recruit and train promising developers.

roles.title: Director, Web & Information Technology
highlights: Developed and led StoryCorps' organization-wide digital strategy in close collaboration with executives, board members and directors.
Crafted and implemented product-led growth (PLG) motions that more than doubled user engagement and user-generated content (UGC).
Redesigned and relaunched the StoryCorps.org website and implemented multiple, high-conversion marketing microsites.

roles.title: Sr. Manager, Information Technology
highlights: Drafted and maintained annual budgets for StoryCorps' digital and IT teams and special projects.
Built and led StoryCorps' data and reporting team, centrally managing all data analysis and key reports for the organization's many programs and initiatives.
Coauthored award-winning grants for organizations like the Knight Foundation, TED, and the Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard University.

roles.title: Manager, Information Technology
highlights: Led organization-wide Salesforce migration and nurtured new SaaS product features like StoryCorps Communities pages, AI/ML transcription at scale, ElasticSearch and WebRTC.
Designed, built and launched Facebook App integrations and other campaigns to engage and grow StoryCorps' audience.
Centralized business and programs systems, migrating from multiple legacy platforms, like FileMaker Pro and physical storage to modern, enterprise-grade cloud services, like AWS.
Developed, tested and maintained StoryCorps' first redundant disaster recovery plan and procured all company hardware, software, and networking systems.

roles.title: Engineer in Residence, Instructor
highlights: Developed and taught a robust web product education curriculum, from hardware and software to IoT solutions.
Advised and collaborated with 30 Weeks leadership on program structure and sustainability.
Mentored designer-founders on technical strategy, revenue models, and scalability for their first product launches.
Advised startup founders on digital product strategy, revenue strategy, sustainability, scalability, audience growth and user retention.
Coached designer-founders as they brought their first products to market and launched their first businesses.

roles.title: Assistant Manager, Information Technology
highlights: Designed and implemented major infrastructure expansion to support increase in personnel and increase impact of sales and implementation teams.
Architected and implemented virtualized network environments, workflow management systems, and disaster recovery strategies for the financial sector in a remote environment.
Contributed to on-prem product strategy with a focus on scalability and centralization in a highly regulated market.

patent.title: Systems and Methods for Allocating System Resources Using Dual-Limit Account Provisioning
patent.summary: Dual-limit provisioning engine allowing dynamic tier quotas, soft/hard threshold management, and resource safety segregation across multitenant cloud architectures.
